description: §42.4: a bare `bool | not` is E-COND-NOT-BOOLEAN; the fixes are `f is given` / `f == true`.
rationale: §42.4 statement 3: "A bare `bool | not` is an error. It SHALL be compile error **E-COND-NOT-BOOLEAN**, and the message SHALL name both fixes". Provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S460 "a′, go" (supersedes S440 Truthiness Q2 for conditions; keeps S440 #4 = (c), Q1, Gotcha Q2, S442).
